items.summary: Recommendation: preserve existing execution, measurement, failure-containment, and security-evidence work; create no new proposals or production changes this cycle. Evidence: 191 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failed-request follow-ups remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven in the 30-day window. Revenue is limited to 2026-09-21: $4.92 aggregate commission, $0 site-attributed; ROI, margin, causal lift, and operational health remain unknown. SearchWoot stays private. Owner decision: authorize or decline sending the prepared Woot permission request.

Recommendation: retain the current safe disposition for SearchWoot and the fleet. The scorecard has no unblocked implementation candidates, so no change_request is warranted. Smallest next step: update existing workstreams with measurement observations, failure dispositions, and security evidence as they become available.
